tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is 19.2, while all paid observations end by H = 0.48. A slow-horizon probe can distinguish a sustained positive response from endogenous reversal and constrain the slow adaptation timescale.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a dual-exponential adaptation model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows do not reliably identify the slow component or its long-horizon reversal.
The pilot has s_grad = 0 throughout, so the sink dependence is unidentified.
Additional fine short-horizon observations would be less directly informative about the target horizon.
It does not resolve the mechanism or slow-horizon ambiguity.
